visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, curly hair wearing a blue denim jacket stands in a brightly lit studio kitchen environment. In the foreground, a wooden table holds a Haidilao Sichuan Spicy Hot Pot bowl, a bag of Haidilao Spicy Fried Chicken, and two bottles of Sprite. The background features clean teal cabinets and light-colored kitchen shelves. The man points at the products with energetic hand movements and a wide, excited smile. (2) The camera switches to a close-up, top-down view of the food. A hand lifts the transparent plastic lid off the Haidilao hot pot bowl, revealing a rich red spicy broth filled with sliced beef, yellow egg dumplings, white tofu blocks, and translucent noodles. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the oily texture of the soup and the steam. (3) Returning to a medium shot, the man holds the hot pot bowl and uses wooden chopsticks to lift a large portion of beef and noodles to his mouth. He opens his mouth wide and takes a hearty bite, chewing with a look of intense satisfaction and squinted eyes. Various yellow and green variety-show style captions appear at the bottom and sides of the frame. (4) In another close-up, a single piece of golden-brown fried chicken is held up by chopsticks against the red Haidilao packaging. The texture of the breading is detailed and bumpy. The man then appears on screen eating the chicken, looking directly at the camera while showing exaggerated expressions of enjoyment and listening to the food. (5) The scene shifts to a mixology demonstration on the same wooden table. A whole peeled tangerine is dropped into a tall, clear glass. A metal muddler is pressed down repeatedly, crushing the fruit into a pulpy orange juice. Ice cubes are dropped into the glass with a visible bounce. Then, clear Sprite is poured from a green bottle, creating white carbonation bubbles. (6) Dark red wine is poured from a glass carafe into the Sprite and tangerine mixture, creating a deep red layer at the top that slowly bleeds into the orange bottom. The man stirs the drink with a glass straw, then takes a long sip. He looks at the camera with a surprised and happy expression, holding the glass up to showcase the colorful layers. (7) The final phase shows the man standing behind the table with all the products: the finished cocktail, two Sprite bottles, the hot pot bowl, and the chicken snack. He speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands to explain a promotion. A large green and yellow text overlay appears detailing a discount at Family Mart valid until January 20th.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Mandarin at a fast pace. The vocal tone is animated and professional, with a high pitch and significant variability. A background music track with an upbeat, electronic pop vibe starts immediately, featuring a driving synthesized beat and a tempo of approximately 128 BPM. The acoustic environment is extremely clean, indicating a studio recording. (2) A distinct plastic clicking sound occurs as a container lid is removed, followed by the narrator's voice continuing with high arousal. The BGM remains at a consistent volume, providing an energetic bed for the narration as he describes the spicy aroma of the hot pot. (3) A loud, sharp percussive crunch sound is heard, clearly enhanced in post-production for emphasis as the man bites into the chicken. This is followed by a shorter slosh sound. The male voice continues with an exaggerated comedic tone, expressing delight while the BGM rhythm maintains a steady pulse. (4) The acoustic environment shifts to include the rhythmic, hollow thudding of a muddler against glass as a tangerine is crushed. This is followed by the bright, high-frequency clinking of ice cubes dropping. A long, sustained fizzing sound of carbonation follows as Sprite is poured from a bottle. (5) A smooth, continuous liquid pouring sound is heard as red wine is added to the glass mixture. The narrator's speech rate slows down slightly for dramatic effect, using a more relaxed and smooth vocal contour to describe the drink's sophistication. The signal-to-noise ratio remains high. (6) The final phase features a surge in vocal intensity and loudness as the narrator delivers a promotional message about a discount. The speech is fast and enunciated with professional clarity. The BGM continues its upbeat loop until the video ends with a quick cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Introduction -> Tasting Experience -> Mixology Tutorial -> Promotional CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the availability of Haidilao spicy hot pot and chicken products at Family Mart convenience stores, while specifically advertising a creative mixology recipe involving Sprite and red wine that pairs well with the spicy food. The video aims to drive sales through a time-limited discount.
